preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: List a contains n distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: There are n-1 edges, each connecting two vertices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is the result of (P * Q - 1) modulo 10^9 + 7.
